physicalNotes: Radius 0.87 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2040 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract): 605,259 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5132 +/- 129 K from Guenther et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2040 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...54G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
